title: StarRocks failover-test: FE leader loss -> re-election
description: The nexus-cli failover-test verb for StarRocks: stop the FE Leader (3-of-3 -> 2-of-3 still majority), verify a Follower is elected Leader and DDL still works, then restore.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql --skip-ssl -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -N -e 'SHOW FRONTENDS' | grep -i leader"

observe.what: identify the current Leader FE (record its IP)
(silent) the Leader FE is down; 2 of 3 remain (still majority)
a surviving Follower has been elected LEADER (sub-minute re-election); DDL/queries continue against the new leader
the restarted FE rejoins as a Follower (back to 3 FE)

whatProves: the 3-FE BDB-JE quorum tolerates a Leader loss (2/3 majority), re-elects a new Leader within a sub-minute window, and the metadata plane stays available -- the failover-test verb measures the re-election RTO.
